marks.gloss_en: כשהוא אומר ״כי שרית עם אלהים״ -- הוי אומר יעקב נעשה שר למלאך
'he strove with an angel and prevailed' (Hos 12:5) -- I do not know who became master of whom; ... you must say Jacob became master over the angel
כשהוא אומר ״ויאמר שלחני״ -- הוי אומר מלאך בכה ליעקב
'he wept and made supplication to him' -- I do not know who wept to whom; ... you must say the angel wept to Jacob
עדיין צריכין אנו למודעי, דמוקים ליה כוליה בחד מקום
Rabban Gamliel: we still need the Modai, who sets the whole of it in one place
וכן הוא אומר: ״גפן ממצרים תסיע״
וכן הוא אומר: ״ובני ישראל פרו וישרצו״

R' Yirmeya bar Abba: 'vine' is Israel; 'three branches' the three pilgrimage festivals; 'as it budded' Israel's time to be fruitful and multiply; 'its blossoms shot forth' Israel's time to be redeemed; 'ripened grapes' Egypt's time to drink the cup of fury
וכן הוא אומר: ״ויז נצחם על בגדי וכל מלבושי אגאלתי״
and so it says: 'their lifeblood (nitzcham) is spattered on My garments, and I have stained (egalti) all My raiment' (Isa 63:3)
והיינו דאמר רבא: שלשה כוסות האמורות במצרים -- Egypt's cup of fury
Rava: why are three cups stated of Egypt? one it drank in Moses' days, one in the days of Pharaoh Nekho, and one it will drink with all the nations
והיינו דשלחו מתם: ליבעי רחמים איתכליא על עליא
[sent from Eretz Yisrael:] let the clusters pray for the leaves, for were it not for the leaves the clusters would not survive
שנאמר ״בקברי אשר כריתי לי״
R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak: 'so I bought her (va'ekreha) for fifteen [pieces] of silver' (Hos 3:2) -- kira is nothing but the language of sale
וכן הוא אומר: ״צרור הכסף לקח בידו״
R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak: 'fifteen' is the fifteenth of Nisan, when Israel were redeemed from Egypt; 'silver' -- these are the righteous
כשהוא אומר ״ואקחה שלשים הכסף ואשליך אתו בית ה׳״ -- הוי אומר שלשים בארץ ישראל
R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak: 'a chomer of barley and a letech of barley' -- these are the forty-five righteous by whom the world endures
והיינו דכתיב: ״הבו שכרי ... וישקלו את שכרי שלשים כסף״
Abaye: and most of them are found in the synagogue under the upper room (tutei apta)
״ברוך״ -- אופנים הוא דאמרי ליה -- it is the ofanim who say it, not the ministering angels
ואיבעית אימא: כיון דאתיהיב רשותא, אתיהיב -- once permission is given [after three words], it is given
וכי מראין לו לאדם מה שהיה? והלא אין מראין לו לאדם אלא מה שעתיד להיות! -- R' Eliezer's patriarchs, matriarchs and tribes were already past
R' Yehoshua: rather, 'vine' is the Torah; 'three branches' Moses, Aaron and Miriam; 'budded' the Sanhedrin; 'ripened grapes' the righteous of every generation
Rabba: [the angel] hinted to him that two princes would issue from him -- the Exilarch in Babylonia and the Nasi in Eretz Yisrael; from here he hinted exile to him

Rav: 'and in the vine were three branches' (Gen 40:10) -- these are three proud princes who issue from Israel in every generation, sometimes two here and one in Eretz Yisrael, sometimes two there and one here
Rava: these are three princes of the nations, who plead in Israel's favour in every generation
R' Eliezer: 'vine' is the world; 'three branches' Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; 'as it budded its blossoms shot forth' the matriarchs; 'its clusters ripened into grapes' the tribes
RYBL (reading it of the gifts): 'vine' is the Torah; 'three branches' the well, the pillar of cloud and the manna; 'budded' the first fruits; 'ripened grapes' the libations
Reish Lakish: this nation is likened to a vine -- its branches the householders, its clusters the Torah scholars, its leaves the unlearned, its tendrils the empty ones of Israel
R' Yehuda: these are thirty righteous of the nations of the world, by whom the nations endure
